newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan July-Sept industry output seen up 0.2% q/q.
newsitem.headline: Japan July-Sept industry output seen up 0.2% q/q.

text.p: Japan's industrial output in the July-to-September quarter is expected to rise 0.2 percent from the previous quarter and rise 4.7 percent from the same period a year earlier, the Trade Ministry said on Friday.
A Trade Ministry official told reporters that production capacity rose 0.1 percent in June from a month earlier, the first rise in 21 months.
He said capacity was on a rising trend, although he later added that he could not make any predictions on future capacity levels.
"All I can say is that, in the long term, (the production capacity figure) is a reflection of the fact that output is on a favourable trend," the official said.
He added that the capacity utilisation rate rose 0.1 percent in the April-to-June quarter, with the index standing at 90.1, the second quarter in a row that the rate exceeded 90.
"These good figures for capacity utilisation and production capacity back up our overall assessment that industrial production continues to be on a gradual rising trend," he said.

He also said that June's industrial production figure was revised downward by a slight 0.1 percentage point, to a decline of 3.2 percent, due to a fall in output of pharmaceuticals. Pharmaceutical production data is not included in the preliminary estimate.
